title: The Bluish Splendour Of Your Eyes
author: Kallol Choudhury
text:
The bluish splendour of your eyes
Gives a rare feeling
Your smiling face
Gives an altogether different feeling.

Sometimes gloominess appears in your firmament.
In this pleasantness sparkles
In your artistic hand
Philosopher`s stone reveals itself.

Where have you been so long
It was difficult to find you.
The tenderness of your hand
Fills the mind enormously.
The glowing emotion of your motivation
Fills the mind greatly.
